paragraphs: Rav Pappa bar Abba. To Ravina; he was corpulent and heavy: Bava Kamma 10b. In Bava Metzia, ‘the limbs of Rav Pappa bar Abba’; see there. He asked Rav Pappa: Bava Metzia 91a. See Yevamot 21b, 46a. He found Rabbah bar Shmuel and asked him, ‘Has the master taught anything about a hired worker?’ Bava Metzia. The sons of Rav Pappa bar Abba raised an objection to Ravina: Yoma 66, end of b. The sons of Rav Pappa bar Abba spoke to Rav Pappa: Shabbat 119a. Rabbi Ana bar Pappa may be his son, named for his grandfather.
